TRSH.lede: Third-generation residential collection across northwest Indiana. The sons are named Trash; the founder was not.

filings.text: Announces fourth son. One page. No operational change disclosed.
Collection rate expansion ahead of guidance for a second quarter.

BYTBN.lede: Certified e-waste destruction for enterprises that need the certificate more than the destruction.

filings.text: Margin compression in the certificate line.
Renews master services agreement with a logistics customer.

MJNK.lede: Curbside bulk pickup sold as a subscription, marketed as a lifestyle brand to people with too much furniture.

filings.text: Fourth attempt. Proceeds earmarked for marketing and fleet.

STBL.lede: Money-market administration. Has never had an exciting quarter and says so in every deck.

filings.text: Board re-nominated unanimously, again.

HYST.lede: Compactor and baler maintenance for retail chains. On call, twenty-four hours, with a two-hour SLA nobody believes.

filings.text: Chief financial officer departs, citing the SLA.

BINN.lede: Roll-off container rental for construction. The name is a pun and the company is aware of it.

filings.text: Fleet age disclosed for the first time. Stock fell 11%.

SKIP.lede: Commercial roll-off and demolition debris. The sons are not involved and this is raised at every annual meeting.

filings.text: Shareholder proposal on succession defeated for the sixth year.

CURB.lede: Route optimisation software sold to haulers, plus a small fleet operated as a reference customer.

filings.text: Reference fleet costs exceed software revenue for a third quarter.

DMPR.lede: Manufactures the containers, and sells almost entirely to the same haulers who compete for the containers.

filings.text: Steel input costs. Fourth consecutive forward warning.

LANF.lede: Owns the holes. Leases airspace by the ton and reports remaining capacity the way a mine reports reserves.

filings.text: Airspace life extends to 41 years on revised assumptions.

SCRP.lede: Ferrous and non-ferrous brokerage. The name has caused forty years of stationery jokes.

filings.text: Acquires a smaller broker with a normal name.

PLUP.lede: Recovered fibre. The patience in the name refers to permitting.

filings.text: Mill restarts after fourteen months idle.

ROT.lede: Municipal organics processing. Odour complaints are the primary KPI and are reported quarterly.

filings.text: Complaint volume down 12%. Stock up 9% on the disclosure.

ODR.lede: Enzyme treatment for transfer stations, sold to exactly the operators who generate the complaints.

filings.text: Customer concentration disclosed. Top three are 61% of revenue.

GLLT.lede: Royalty trust holding a share of landfill gas rights. Pays monthly and explains nothing.

filings.text: Distribution maintained. No guidance, as is policy.

PIGE.lede: Buys brownfield sites, remediates partially, leases to storage and logistics.

filings.text: Remediation overruns at three sites. Cost estimate withdrawn.

RACC.lede: Household storage and bins sold direct, named after the animals that get into bins.

filings.text: Customer acquisition cost disclosed. Investors recalibrate.

SLDG.lede: Biosolids handling for municipal water districts. Contracts run decades and are won on patience.

filings.text: Three contracts renewed, all twenty-year terms.

TANG.lede: Waste audits for ESG reporting. Produces the number, then sells the reduction against the number.

filings.text: Audit revenue and reduction revenue diverge for the first time.

BRWN.lede: Industrial redevelopment. Buys what nobody will touch and touches it.

filings.text: Portfolio occupancy 94%. Two assets sold above basis.

LEAF.lede: Seasonal yard-waste subscription. Revenue is 71% in a nine-week window and the company is at peace with it.

filings.text: Q2 concentration disclosed as a principal risk.

MOSS.lede: Heavy equipment refurbishment. Buys back its own machines at twelve years and resells at fifteen.

filings.text: Refurbishment mix now 38% of revenue.

GRAV.lede: Aggregate supply for road base. Owns three pits, permits two, operates one.

filings.text: Second pit permitted after six years. Stock barely moved.

SORT.lede: Optical sorting retrofits for materials recovery facilities. Sells throughput; accuracy is the customer's staffing problem.

filings.text: Backlog up, installations slipping against schedule.

RECL.lede: Worker-owned co-operative doing commercial recycling. Shares a chief executive with STBL and nobody has noticed.

filings.text: Membership buyout tranche funded.
